summary: The second UX browser review run of Phase 3 (P3.8) of track storytime_look_20261107 ran at role_base_sha 583c9ce805d6d60f34d8f5788aaee69e6a09c74e, which is the current HEAD. The build of the app passed this time, because commit ff4a4b86d fixed the four type errors that stopped run 1. The browser then ran, and every protected page answered the sign-in page. The cause is the harness: browser.mjs gave the session cookie to the phone context before the sign-in filled it, so that context held no cookie. A diagnostic with curl shows the same build answers the protected page with HTTP 200, so the app is not at fault. The harness fix is applied and checked. The status is inconclusive, because no value of P3.8 exists. The review needs one more launch. No phone result is claimed.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocking, harness] ux-browser-review: the phone context of the harness held no session cookie, so every protected page of the seven weeks answered the sign-in page and no tap could run. The harness of the run folder called context.addCookies(cookies) before signInRow() filled the cookie array, so the call passed an empty list. The proxy of the app sends a request with no session cookie to the sign-in page, and the reader then renders no word, so the seven capture rows read signed_in=0 and the six tap rows time out on the selector [data-word]. The app is not at fault: a diagnostic of the same build signs in with curl, reads the session cookie from the jar, and gets HTTP 200 with the week page for the path /th/st/2/1. The fix is applied: the addCookies call now runs after signInRow(), and node --check on browser.mjs passes. The review needs one more launch of launch.sh. Log tail: logs/playwright.log line 5 'FAIL: week w01 capture console_errors=0 failed_requests=0 signed_in=0', line 25 'FAIL: w02 tap own clip the tap raises an error: TimeoutError: page.waitForSelector: Timeout 20000ms exceeded.', and line 78 'FAIL: taps checked taps_checked=0'. The run ended with exit code 1 at the line '=== Total: FAIL rows present ==='.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Note] ux-browser-review: the seven captures of this run are each 12619 bytes, well under the limit of 500 KB, and each shows the sign-in page of the Thai locale with an empty user field, so no account data of any other account sits in them. The captures do not show the week pages, so they prove nothing about the imported content.

N2 [Note] ux-browser-review: the app ties the pressed state of the mode buttons to a playing clip, so the aria-pressed of the My turn button reads false between the click on the button and the first clip. The harness reads that state once before the first clip and once after it, and the labeled value wNN_my_turn_pressed_after_clip carries the state that a child sees while the clip plays. This is the app behaviour and not a defect.

N3 [Note] ux-browser-review: the run folder held a stale accounts.csv with one seeded test row of a cancelled attempt, inside the repository. The run script now seeds the account in a new folder under /tmp/opencode, and the folder was removed before the launch of this run.

The row count: logs/playwright.log line 79 reads row_count=22, with 16 FAIL rows and 6 PASS rows. The PASS rows are the sign-in and the word coverage rows of w03 to w07, which pass on empty word lists.

The cause of the FAIL rows, first proof: the capture of w01 shows the sign-in page of the Thai locale with an empty user field (measure/runs/storytime_look_20261107/ux-p3-3d35c47fa/captures/w01.jpg). The seven captures hold the same 12619 bytes each, so all seven show the same page.

The cause of the FAIL rows, second proof: a diagnostic against the same build and the same database pattern signs in with curl, reads the session cookie __Host-st_session from the jar, and gets HTTP 200 with no redirect for the path /th/st/2/1. The body holds the week page with the title of week 1 and the three part tiles, and it holds no sign-in form. The app accepts a fresh session cookie.

The cause of the FAIL rows, third proof: a probe of SYSTEM Chrome shows that Chrome stores the cookie __Host-st_session over http://localhost, and that copying the jar into a new context as it is keeps the cookie, which reads COOKIE_PRESENT. The browser and the copy of the cookie are not at fault.

The cause of the FAIL rows, the defect itself: browser.mjs called context.addCookies(cookies) before signInRow() filled the array, so the phone context received an empty list. The proxy of the app sends a request with no session cookie to the sign-in page, so every protected route of the seven weeks answered the sign-in page, the reader rendered no word, and the six tap rows timed out on the selector [data-word].

Harness fix 5, applied after the run: the addCookies call in browser.mjs now runs after signInRow(), and the check node --check on browser.mjs (exit 0) passes. The next launch of launch.sh uses the fixed harness.

Harness fix 1 of run 1: browser.mjs line 148 used the selector 'button[data-mode-button]:nth-of-type(2)', which matches no element, because the three mode buttons are the third, the fourth and the fifth button children of their parent in apps/storytime/app/[locale]/st/[level]/[week]/reader.tsx lines 535 to 582. The fix uses page.locator('button[data-mode-button]').nth(1).click(), a trusted click.

Harness fix 2 of run 1: the two word taps used dispatchEvent of an untrusted MouseEvent, which gives no trusted event and no user activation. The fix uses page.locator('[data-word][tabindex]') with an exact text filter for the clip word, and page.locator('[data-word]:not([tabindex])') with the same filter for the word with no clip. Both use a real click.

Harness fix 3 of run 1: the no-clip tap of w02 now names the removed word. The harness reads the key of measure/runs/storytime_look_20261107/ux-p3-3d35c47fa/removed-entry.json, which holds 'balls', and picks the word whose lower-case text equals that key.

Harness fix 4 of run 1: the line tapsChecked = 7 was hard-coded. The function weekTaps now returns the number of taps it made, and the harness sums the six own-clip taps of w02 to w07 and the one no-clip tap of w02.

test_strategy_violations: The browser review of P3.8 produced no value. The phone context held no session cookie, so the seven week pages were never opened, the seven captures show the sign-in page, the seven tap lines read missing, and taps_checked reads 0 against a floor of 7.
live_contract_violations: No live contract of the child page was measured in the browser. The app itself answers the protected page with HTTP 200 for a fresh session cookie, as the curl diagnostic of the same build shows.
webbridge_evidence: The webbridge browser panel was not used. The review used the prepared harness of the run folder (Playwright with SYSTEM Chrome), and the harness never opened a protected page because the phone context held no session cookie.
The only image evidence of this run is the seven captures of the run folder, and each capture shows the sign-in page of the Thai locale. No capture shows a week page, a reader page or a tap.
No accessibility snapshot and no interaction record of a child page exists for this run.
